outpatient_inpatient_ratio.name: 门诊人次数与出院人次数比
outpatient_inpatient_ratio.sql: SELECT 0 as result, '暂未接入挂号系统数据' as remark

downward_transfer_vol.name: 下转患者人次数
downward_transfer_vol.sql: SELECT 0 as result, '暂未接入双向转诊系统' as remark

day_surgery_ratio.name: 日间手术占择期手术比例
day_surgery_ratio.sql: SELECT 0 as result, '暂未接入日间手术标识' as remark

surgery_patient_ratio.name: 出院患者手术占比
surgery_patient_ratio.sql: SELECT COUNT(*)*100.0/(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM surgery_records) as result, '出院患者手术占比(模拟)' as indicator FROM surgery_records WHERE 1=1 {t} {d}

weichuang_ratio.name: 出院患者微创手术占比
weichuang_ratio.sql: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN is_weichuang = 1 THEN 1 END)*100.0/NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) as result, '微创手术占比(%)' as indicator FROM surgery_records WHERE 1=1 {t} {d}

level4_ratio.name: 出院患者四级手术比例
level4_ratio.sql: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN surgery_level = 4 THEN 1 END)*100.0/NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) as result, '四级手术比例(%)' as indicator FROM surgery_records WHERE 1=1 {t} {d}

medical_service_income_ratio.name: 医疗服务收入占医疗收入比例
medical_service_income_ratio.sql: SELECT 0 as result, '暂未接入收费明细分类' as remark

personnel_exp_ratio.name: 人员支出占业务支出比重
personnel_exp_ratio.sql: SELECT (SUM(personnel_expenditure)/SUM(medical_income))*100.0 as result, '人员支出占比(%)' as indicator FROM financial_records WHERE 1=1 {t}

asset_liability_ratio.name: 资产负债率
asset_liability_ratio.sql: SELECT (SUM(liabilities)/SUM(assets))*100.0 as result, '资产负债率(%)' as indicator FROM financial_records WHERE 1=1 {t}

outpatient_satisfaction.name: 门诊患者满意度
outpatient_satisfaction.sql: SELECT AVG(outpatient_score) as result, '门诊满意度(分)' as indicator FROM satisfaction_records WHERE 1=1 {t}

inpatient_satisfaction.name: 住院患者满意度
inpatient_satisfaction.sql: SELECT AVG(inpatient_score) as result, '住院满意度(分)' as indicator FROM satisfaction_records WHERE 1=1 {t}

staff_satisfaction.name: 医务人员满意度
staff_satisfaction.sql: SELECT 0 as result, '暂未接入内部员工调查系统' as remark

cmix.name: 病例组合指数(CMI)
cmix.sql: SELECT 0 as result, '暂未接入DRG/DIP结算系统' as remark

antibiotic_usage_intensity.name: 抗菌药物使用强度(DDDs)
antibiotic_usage_intensity.sql: SELECT 0 as result, '暂未接入HIS药品消耗数据' as remark

research_fund_per_100_staff.name: 每百名卫生技术人员科研项目经费
research_fund_per_100_staff.sql: SELECT 0 as result, '暂未接入科研管理系统' as remark
